## Project Exploration Report: /Users/admin/project/admin/ui

### 1. Framework & Technology Stack

**Primary Framework:** **Next.js 16.1.0** with React 19.2.3

**Key Technologies:**
- **React:** 19.2.3 (latest)
- **Next.js:** 16.1.0 (app router architecture)
- **TypeScript:** 5.x
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4.x with PostCSS
- **React Compiler:** Enabled (babel-plugin-react-compiler 1.0.0)
- **ESLint:** 9.x with Next.js config

### 2. Directory Structure

```
/Users/admin/project/admin/ui/
├── src/
│   ├── app/                    # Next.js App Router
│   │   ├── layout.tsx          # Root layout with Header & Sidebar
│   │   ├── page.tsx            # Home page (redirects to /dashboard)
│   │   ├── globals.css         # Global styles with Tailwind theme
│   │   ├── favicon.ico
│   │   ├── dashboard/
│   │   │   └── page.tsx        # Morpheme Analysis Dashboard
│   │   ├── engine-dashboard/
│   │   │   └── page.tsx        # Commerce Search Engine Dashboard
│   │   ├── ai-dict/
│   │   │   ├── focused/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx    # AI Dictionary Focused Review
│   │   │   └── triage/
│   │   │       └── page.tsx    # AI Dictionary Triage Management
│   │   └── system-dict/
│   │       └── page.tsx        # System Dictionary (Read-only)
│   └── components/
│       ├── Header.tsx          # Top navigation header
│       └── Sidebar.tsx         # Left sidebar navigation
├── public/                     # Static assets
├── next.config.ts             # Next.js configuration
├── tsconfig.json              # TypeScript configuration
├── postcss.config.mjs         # PostCSS configuration
├── eslint.config.mjs          # ESLint configuration
└── package.json
```

### 3. Page Implementations & Routing Patterns

The app uses **Next.js App Router** (file-based routing in `/src/app`):

| Route | File | Purpose | Status |
|-------|------|---------|--------|
| `/` | `page.tsx` | Home page - redirects to `/dashboard` | Static redirect |
| `/dashboard` | `dashboard/page.tsx` | Morpheme Analysis Dashboard | Fully implemented |
| `/engine-dashboard` | `engine-dashboard/page.tsx` | Elasticsearch monitoring dashboard | Fully implemented |
| `/ai-dict/focused` | `ai-dict/focused/page.tsx` | AI dictionary focused review interface | Fully implemented |
| `/ai-dict/triage` | `ai-dict/triage/page.tsx` | AI dictionary triage/management system | Fully implemented |
| `/system-dict` | `system-dict/page.tsx` | System dictionary browser (read-only) | Fully implemented |

**Layout Structure:**
- All pages share a common `layout.tsx` that wraps content with Header and Sidebar
- Header provides navigation and user info
- Sidebar provides navigation menu (expandable "사전" menu with sub-items)
- Main content area uses flexbox layout with overflow handling

### 4. Package.json Dependencies

**Production Dependencies:**
- `next@16.1.0` - Next.js framework
- `react@19.2.3` - React library
- `react-dom@19.2.3` - React DOM bindings

**Development Dependencies:**
- `@tailwindcss/postcss@^4` - Tailwind CSS with PostCSS
- `@types/node@^20` - Node.js type definitions
- `@types/react@^19` - React type definitions
- `@types/react-dom@^19` - React DOM type definitions
- `babel-plugin-react-compiler@1.0.0` - React compiler (experimental)
- `eslint@^9` - Linting
- `eslint-config-next@16.1.0` - Next.js ESLint config
- `tailwindcss@^4` - Tailwind CSS utility framework
- `typescript@^5` - TypeScript compiler

**npm Scripts:**
```bash
npm run dev      # Start development server
npm run build    # Build for production
npm start        # Start production server
npm run lint     # Run ESLint
```

### 5. Design System & UI Component Library

**Styling Approach:**
- **Tailwind CSS 4.x** with utility-first approach
- **Custom CSS Theme** defined in `/src/app/globals.css`
- **Material Symbols** icon library (Google's Material Design icons)
- **No external UI component library** - components are built from scratch using Tailwind classes

**Custom Theme Variables (in globals.css):**
```css
--color-primary: #3b82f6
--color-corporate-blue: #0066ff
--color-background-light: #f5f6f8
--color-surface-light: #ffffff
--color-border-light: #e2e8f0
--color-text-primary: #111827
--color-text-secondary: #6b7280
--font-display: "Inter", "sans-serif"
```

**Custom Utility Classes:**
- `.corporate-header-shadow` - Subtle box shadow for headers
- `.nav-link-active` - Styled active navigation links
- `.nav-link-inactive` - Styled inactive navigation links

**UI Patterns Used:**
- Cards with rounded corners and subtle borders (Tailwind's `rounded-xl border border-gray-200`)
- Table designs with striped rows and hover effects
- Badge/pill components for status indicators
- Material Symbols icons for visual indicators
- Color-coded status badges (blue, green, red, orange, purple, emerald, etc.)
- Progress bars and progress indicators
- Modal/card-based layouts for content
- Tri-column layout in triage page (pending, approved, rejected)
- Responsive grid layouts (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2` etc.)

**Font:**
- Inter font from Google Fonts (loaded in layout.tsx)
- Applied as `--font-display` CSS variable

**Icon System:**
- Google Material Symbols Outlined font (loaded in layout.tsx)
- Extensively used throughout for UI icons and status indicators

### 6. Configuration Files

**next.config.ts:**
- Minimal config
- React Compiler enabled (`reactCompiler: true`)

**tsconfig.json:**
- Target: ES2017
- Strict mode enabled
- Path alias: `@/*` → `./src/*`
- React JSX: `react-jsx`

**postcss.config.mjs:**
- Uses `@tailwindcss/postcss` plugin for Tailwind CSS 4.x

**eslint.config.mjs:**
- Uses Next.js core-web-vitals and TypeScript configs
- Ignores `.next/`, `out/`, `build/`, and `next-env.d.ts`

### Key Insights

1. **Modern Next.js Setup** - Uses latest versions (Next.js 16.1, React 19.2)
2. **TypeScript Throughout** - Strict mode enabled for type safety
3. **No External Component Library** - Custom components built entirely with Tailwind CSS
4. **Language**: The app is in **Korean** (비즈니스 언어: 한국어)
5. **Purpose**: Admin dashboard for managing AI-powered morphological dictionaries and search engine infrastructure
6. **Clean Architecture**: Separation of concerns with layout, components, and pages
7. **Accessible**: Uses semantic HTML and Material Symbols for accessibility
8. **Performance Optimized**: React Compiler enabled for automatic optimization
